comparison.objective: Route a wire between posts and seat its free span in a second clip while preserving first-clip retention; candidate extracts a wire terminal from its cavity.
comparison.physical_skill: PR tests bimanual cable routing, tension management, and clip insertion. Candidate tests extraction-tool guidance, tang depression, and opposing tool/wire forces.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires correct connected-span routing, both clips seated, no joint gap, retained green end, and released stability. Candidate requires the designated contact removed while every neighbor stays retained and connector/crimp damage is avoided.
comparison.reason: One tests routing and adding retention; the other tests selective release and removal of an internal terminal.
